message.content:
Let Fresh’s volume be \(V\). Since Fresh costs \$1.00 per unit volume, Fresh’s total price is \(V\) dollars.

- Bright is \(60\%\) more expensive than Fresh, so Bright costs  
  \[
  1.6V
  \]
- Glow is \(25\%\) less expensive than Bright, so Glow costs  
  \[
  0.75(1.6V)=1.2V
  \]
- Glow has \(33\frac13\%\) more volume than Fresh, so Glow’s volume is  
  \[
  V\left(1+\frac13\right)=\frac43V
  \]

Thus Glow’s cost per unit volume is  
\[
\frac{1.2V}{\frac43V}=1.2\cdot\frac34=0.9
\]
dollars per unit volume, which is \(90\) cents.

The answer is 90.
